enabled.name: Enable Roll Lessons
enabled.hint: Record modifier breakdowns when rolls are made. Applies to rolls made after this is turned on.

visibility.name: Who sees the breakdown
visibility.hint: Choose whether players or only the GM see the breakdown panel.

detail.name: Detail level
detail.hint: Beginner shows the rule text for each modifier. Advanced shows only the labels and values.

expanded.name: Open breakdowns by default
expanded.hint: Show each breakdown open under its roll (this client only). On by default.

customRules.name: Custom rule text (JSON)
customRules.hint: Optional. JSON that overrides the wording of any rule, for example {"prof.expertise": {"title": "Expertise", "text": "My table wording."}}. Leave empty to use the defaults.

debug.name: Debug logging
debug.hint: Write roll configuration details to the browser console (F12). Use this when reporting a problem.

rollLog.name: Roll log
rollLog.hint: Record every roll's breakdown and every Error or Unclear report to Data/roll-lessons-logs/ (one folder per day, a new file every 30 seconds while rolls are made) so problems can be found and fixed later. Written by the GM's browser. Old logs are deleted by hand from that folder.

hideZeroDamage.name: Hide damage that can only be 0
hideZeroDamage.hint: Hides damage rolls with no dice and no bonus, such as True Strike's extra Radiant damage below level 5, from chat cards and breakdowns. The roll is kept in the data.

reportButtons.name: Error and Unclear buttons
reportButtons.hint: Show two buttons under every breakdown so players and the GM can report a wrong or unclear explanation. Reports are saved in the roll log and listed in the Roll Lessons reports window.

effectCheck.name: Effect check on spell and feature cards
effectCheck.hint: Under a spell or feature card that creates effects (Rage, Mage Armor, Bless, Shield), say when an effect never reached the creature it is for, or no target was selected, and apply it with one click. Shown to the GM and the player who used it.

gmTodo.name: GM to-do bar
gmTodo.hint: Shows an orange bar at the top of the GM's screen when something needs the GM to apply it: effects from spell and feature cards that never reached their creature, damage or healing rolled against a target whose hit points did not change, and effects turned off that a roll needed. Each item has the button that fixes it.

panel.noReason: dnd5e did not report a reason. It may have been chosen in the roll dialog or with a held key.
panel.unknownSource: Added after the roll was set up
panel.critDoubled: doubled by the critical hit to
panel.attackCrit: {name}: Critical Hit (natural 20). Hits regardless of AC.
panel.rulesNotLoaded: The rule text was not loaded in this browser when this panel was built (status: {state} {error}). Reopen the panel to retry.
panel.noRuleText: Roll Lessons has no rule text for "{key}". This is a Roll Lessons gap; it is recorded in the roll log.
panel.noKey: This part of the roll could not be matched to any source. It is recorded in the roll log.
panel.rulesFailedTitle: Rule text could not be loaded
panel.rulesFailedText: This browser could not load Roll Lessons' rule text ({error}) from {url}. Close and reopen this panel to retry. If it keeps failing, reload the page (F5).
panel.noSentence: No rule text found on this effect or the item it came from. Add a description to the effect so this row can explain itself.
panel.warnOnce: Warning: {name} applies to one roll only. This roll uses it up, so remove the effect now.
panel.warnUsed: Warning: an earlier roll already used {name}. It applies to one roll only and should have been removed before this roll.
panel.warnExpired: Warning: the duration of {name} has run out, but the effect is still on the creature.
panel.warnEarly: Warning: {name} was applied by the same casting of {source} this save is against. It should only be applied after a failed save, so it should not change this roll.
panel.warnEarlyMaybe: Warning: {name} comes from {source}, which this save is against. If it was applied by this same casting, it was applied too early: it should only be applied after a failed save. If it came from an earlier casting, it applies.
panel.saveWhyAbility: {item} calls for a {ability} saving throw, so this roll adds the {ability} modifier. The spell or ability always names which ability resists it.
panel.saveWhat: A saving throw is a d20 roll to resist a threat such as a spell. The Difficulty Class (DC) is the number to reach: a total equal to or higher than the DC succeeds.
panel.saveResisted: {who} resists {item}: its effect on a failed save does not happen.
panel.warnNoMod: Warning: dnd5e added no ability modifier to this attack, so the total is likely wrong. Every attack roll adds an ability modifier.
panel.off_off: {name} is on this creature but turned off, so its {what} is not part of this roll.
panel.off_expired: {name} is on this creature but its duration ran out, so Foundry turned it off and its {what} is not part of this roll.
panel.off_suppressed: {name} is suppressed, usually because its item is not equipped or attuned, so its {what} is not part of this roll.
panel.masteryNoFeature: Warning: {name} has no Weapon Mastery feature or Weapon Master feat, so this mastery comes from the character sheet's setting, not from a feature. In the 2024 Player's Handbook, Weapon Mastery is a level 1 feature of Barbarians, Fighters, Paladins, Rangers and Rogues, and the Weapon Master feat (level 4+) grants it.
panel.noTarget: Warning: no target was selected, so this attack can't be compared to an Armor Class and Hit or Miss can't be shown.

warn.system: Roll Lessons only works with the dnd5e system.
warn.customRules: Roll Lessons: the custom rule text is not valid JSON and was ignored.

report.hintError: Report a number, source or rule in this breakdown that is wrong.
report.hintUnclear: Report an explanation in this breakdown that is hard to understand.
report.introError: Tell the GM which part of this breakdown is wrong.
report.introUnclear: Tell the GM which part of this breakdown is hard to understand.
report.disclaimer: Your comment is saved in this world's roll log. The GM may share it with the Roll Lessons developer to improve explanations. Don't include real names or personal details.
report.logged: Report saved in the roll log.
report.queued: No GM is online. Your report is saved in this browser and will be sent when a GM connects.
report.resent: Roll Lessons: {count} saved report(s) sent to the GM.
report.received: Roll Lessons: {user} reported {category} on a roll. Open Settings > Roll Lessons reports to read it.

reports.title: Roll Lessons reports
reports.menuHint: Read the Error and Unclear reports players and GMs sent from the breakdown panels.
reports.notInLog: The message is not loaded in the chat log. Scroll up in chat and try again.

fix.once: How to fix: on {who}'s sheet, open Effects and delete {name} now.
fix.used: How to fix: on {who}'s sheet, open Effects, delete {name}, then reroll this roll.
fix.expired: How to fix: on {who}'s sheet, open Effects, delete {name}, then reroll this roll.
fix.early: How to fix: on {who}'s sheet, open Effects, delete {name}, and reroll the save. Apply {name} only if the save fails.
fix.earlyMaybe: How to fix: if {name} came from this casting, delete it from {who}'s Effects, reroll the save, and apply it only if the save fails.
fix.noSentence: How to fix: open the effect {name}, go to its Details tab, and paste the rule sentence into Description. Later rolls will show it.
fix.noMod: How to fix: reroll and pick {expected} in the roll window's ability box. If the roll window has no ability box, set the ability on the item's attack activity.
fix.rageMissing: How to fix: reroll the damage and type {rage} in the roll window's Situational Bonus box.
fix.off_off: How to fix: on {who}'s sheet, use {name} again (or open Effects and turn it on), then reroll.
fix.off_expired: How to fix: if {name} should still be active, use it again on {who}'s sheet, then reroll.
fix.off_suppressed: How to fix: equip or attune the item that grants {name} on {who}'s sheet, then reroll.
fix.mastery: How to fix: on {name}'s sheet, remove {weapon} from Weapon Mastery in the weapon proficiency settings, unless a feature you haven't added grants it.
fix.noTarget: How to fix: before rolling, target the creature: hover over its token and press T. Then roll the attack again.

apply.title: Roll Lessons: effect not applied
apply.state_empty: {effect} on {names} was made by hand and changes nothing.
apply.why: Until it is, its modifiers are not counted: {what}.
apply.whyGeneric: Until it is, its modifiers are not counted.
apply.fixApply: How to fix: click the button below to apply it to {names}.
apply.noTargets: No target was selected when {item} was used, so {effect} reached no one.
apply.fixTargets: How to fix: target each creature it affects (hover over its token and press T), then click Apply to my targets.
apply.noneTargeted: Roll Lessons: target the creatures first (hover over a token and press T).
apply.noGM: Roll Lessons: a GM must be online to apply effects to creatures you don't own.
apply.failed: Roll Lessons: the effect could not be applied. See the console (F12).
apply.todoNoTargets: {who} used {item} with no target selected, so its effect reached no one.

todo.head: Roll Lessons: {count} to apply (click to open)
todo.notice: Roll Lessons, GM to apply: {text} See the orange bar at the top of the screen.
todo.failed: Roll Lessons: that action failed. See the console (F12).
todo.damageNotApplied: {who} rolled {total} {types} damage against {names}, but their hit points did not change.
todo.healingNotApplied: {who} rolled {total} healing for {names}, but their hit points did not change.
todo.damageWhy: dnd5e does not take damage off hit points by itself: someone has to apply it. Apply full damage on a hit or failed save, or half when the spell says a successful save takes half.
todo.healingWhy: dnd5e does not add healing to hit points by itself: someone has to apply it.
todo.offEffect: {name} on {who} is turned off, and a roll just made would have used it.
todo.offWhy: If it should still be active (for example Rage was used again), turn it on so its modifiers count.
